questions.stem: Q1. Which statement correctly describes the role of the supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei in pituitary hormone secretion?

options.label: A
options.text: The supraoptic nucleus primarily produces oxytocin, while the paraventricular nucleus primarily produces ADH.

options.label: B
options.text: The supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei contain neurons that release hormones from axon terminals in the anterior pituitary gland.

options.label: C
options.text: Magnocellular neurons in these nuclei synthesize ADH and oxytocin and release them from the posterior pituitary gland.

options.label: D
options.text: The supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei are located in the anterior pituitary gland and control its hormone secretion directly.
